intervention: Expose 24 benchmark-only full-resolution shader transport, hold, memory and temporal-state constants through P10-P15, accept 42-column persistent replay plans, and screen 33 shader-layer configurations with matrix-v5 while preserving production defaults.
qualitative_observation: Shader-layer controls are demonstrably active: small-object trail and low-contrast flash metrics change dramatically, so the benchmark-only constant path is valid. However, the large-object p99_max is saturated at essentially the full 235-to-24 sRGB object/background contrast for every candidate, and the reported 233.333 ms clear time is the seven-frame screening recovery ceiling when no clear is observed, not an actual measured clearing time. Therefore matrix-v5 cannot reliably rank large visible trailing yet. Fix the trail measurement before promoting any shader candidate. low_contrast_priority is promising for weak flashes, but its higher peak output delta and the censored large-trail metrics require re-evaluation under the corrected metric.
